summary: Same grill re-recorded against the approval-marked plan version (content unchanged besides the marker). Plan grilled against decision 0119, the roadmap ACs, and a full code trace; the four open design forks were put to Ravi (AskUserQuestion, 2026-08-10) and locked: auto-register+seed on recognition; recognised = DM-established person; delete the old DM Yes/No flow; Telegram+Slack v1 with Discord manual-fallback and Teams documented-manual.
gaps: The existing Telegram flow cannot mint a first approver and never posts in the group - 0119's core gap, confirmed in code.
Desired-state reconcile rejects approvers who aren't message-ingested participants, so a naive seed on a fresh group silently lands in 'skipped'.
Aliases auto-mint for any group speaker, so 'has an alias' is weaker than 0119's 'existing DM' phrasing.
replaceConversationApprovers is a destructive full replace; a re-join must not clobber a configured allowlist.
A direct conversation_approvers DB write is erased by the next settings reconcile (settings are authority).
Slack needs an app-manifest event subscription + scopes; code lands dark until ops applies it.
Retired aliases THROW from resolve rather than returning unresolved.
contradictions: Auto-registration on recognition replaces the existing DM-approver Yes/No registration gate - a trust-model change, not just an addition.
resolutions: The shared bootstrap mints the installer as first approver and posts the in-group ack - pinned by AC1.
AC5 makes reconcile-survival a hard criterion: installer upserted as conversation participant at seed time (join event = membership evidence); reconcile check stays intact.
Ravi locked DM-established recognition (alias resolves AND a direct-kind conversation exists); small repo query implements it.
Already-registered guard + preserve-on-empty behavior pinned by required tests (AC3).
The seed goes only through applyConversationInstallToSettings + writeDesiredRuntimeSettings.
Slack ops dependency documented in docs/operations/slack-app-install.md and flagged in the PR; doctor warns on missing scopes.
The retired-alias throw is caught and mapped to the unrecognised path (fail-closed).
Ravi locked auto-register+seed: recognition IS the gate; the 0119 amendment records the supersession explicitly.
